dataset.description: This DMP will contain optical property data of novel organic compounds studied in the project with goal to make them available for other research works studying derivatives of these molecules or their practical application in photonic devices.

distribution.title: The goal of this data collection is to collect the main linear and nonlinear optical property data of organic molecules that can be used to screen for their photonic applications.
